assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Each cell's number is compared against its receipt field by scratch/emit_table.py:check, which compares float(token) to float(fmt(row[field])) with fmt the generator's own formatter; reverting either corrected cell makes it redden (verified: limited 2000 read_image_error, limited 5000 exact_image_error, EXIT=1), so the two cells under correction are genuinely guarded by the check.

The check compares the table against the generator's own rendering of the receipt (float(fmt(row[field]))), not the raw field, so a formatter that rounds a value (e.g. %.5f on a ratio near 6e-4) passes while the served number differs from the receipt by about 0.6%; it is a non-hand-editing check at generator rounding, not a fidelity check.

durability.reason: The change makes six GPU-only rows skip off the GPU with a stated reason. Its durable guard is the H200 lane, where all six rows pass every assertion; that lane runs the same test file. A CPU-side guard cannot exercise a measurement that refuses non-GPU backends by design.

findings.text: follow-on: the claim that 'a re-read of the table against every field names any cell that disagrees' rests on scratch/emit_table.py, which is uncommitted under the run directory and compares the table against the generator's own rendering (float(fmt(row[field]))) rather than the raw receipt value, so the guarantee is neither durable (unreachable once the run directory is cleaned) nor a fidelity check against the receipt itself, only that the table was not hand-edited at generator rounding.

follow-on: the diverted 2000 saddle ratios are served as 0.00062 / 0.00022 where h200-results/diverted-2000.json gives 0.0006163830118077075 / 0.00022163736352440343; the generator's %.5f decimal rendering lost a significant figure the previous text carried (6.16e-04 / 2.22e-04), so this row's reported value now differs from its receipt by about 0.6%, a precision regression introduced by the rewrite whose stated purpose was receipt fidelity.

item_verdicts.assertions: The delta adds no test assertion; its correctness is carried by the run-scratch checker scratch/emit_table.py --check, whose only recorded output is scratch/check.txt (78 numbers, 0 mismatches). justifications.durability: No committed test guards the served table; the only checker is scratch/emit_table.py under the run directory, which no CI or future reader can reach once that directory is cleaned, so an edited or regressed table reddens nothing in the repository.
justifications.evidence: The correction is recorded and reproducible: emit_table.py --check over the committed fragment reports 'compared 78 numbers over 6 rows' and 'mismatches=0', and the reverted table reddens the same checker, but the checker itself is uncommitted scratch (see durability).
justifications.fit: The fragment keeps the evidence-doc idiom and adds no forbidden name, but the generated table's %.5f rendering at analytic-moment-rows.html:40 rounds the diverted 2000 saddle ratios below the precision of the surrounding cells.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/analytic-moment-rows.html:38,40 now carry 2.6695e-06 and 3.1917e-05, matching h200-results/limited-2000.json and limited-5000.json, and all 78 table numbers reconcile with the six receipt JSONs.
justifications.reuse: The landed change adds no definition to the repository; a search over scripts/ and nova/ for an existing receipt-to-evidence-table generator (grep for BOOKING_ROW, h200-results, operand_cache_root, and receipt/table generators) found only per-experiment measure scripts, not an owner this would fork.
